# Space Shooter

A 3d space shooter with mission objectives and enemy AI.

{height=300}![screenshot](Packages/com.hutonggames.playmaker/Editor/Addons/Packages/com.hutonggames.playmaker.samples.space-shooter.jpg)

NOTE: This sample uses the new Input System.

## Features

- Uses [Data Tables](docs:guides/using-data-tables/) to define missions and messages.
- Uses [Flight addon](docs:actions/flight-actions/) for 3d flight controls and AI.
- Uses [TargetManagers](docs:guides/ui-widgets/target-managers/) for OffScreen and Target  Indicators.
- Uses [Interactables](docs:guides/interactables/) system for pickups.
- Uses [DataComponents](docs:components/data-component/) to define PickupInfo.
- Uses [Object Pools](docs:actions/object-pool-actions/) for laser bolts.

## Input Action Map

Input actions are defined in the **SpaceShooter** input action map.
